context: The player is reading a bronze plaque on a sarcophagus in an abandoned chapel dedicated to Jergal, the stoic judge of the dead; the inscription frames the interred as a “Guardian of Tombs” and speaks of atonement through knowledge. Canon background: Jergal was once locked away by the god Helm as penance for his role in empowering the Dead Three. Though effectively immortal and emotionally detached, he is bound by oath to aid the living and may be encountered after the party clears undead or later in camp to offer limited services (including resurrection). The line on the plaque echoes that theme of judgment, duty, and enforced atonement.
